newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Posteel says seeks 700T of ferro-chrome.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Posteel says seeks 700T of ferro-chrome.

text.p: South Korea's Posco Steel Service and Sales Co Ltd (Posteel) said on Wednesday it will invite tenders to buy 700 tonnes of medium-carbon ferro-chrome by 11:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on March 12.
Posteel is an affiliate of Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd, South Korea's largest steel maker.

A Posteel official said it will also invite tenders for 136 tonnes of low-carbon ferro-manganese, 51 tonnes of ferro-vanadium, 434 tonnes of titanium sponge, and 306 tonnes of ferro-phosphorus at the same time.
The official said if it passes on the tenders in whole or partially due to high prices, it will re-tender on March 19.

Arrival of ferro-chrome was set for May 30 (200 tonnes)/June 30 (200 tonnes)/July 30 (300 tonnes), ferro-manganese for May 30 (85 tonnes)/June 30 (51 tonnes) and ferro-vanadium for May 30 (34 tonnes)/June 30 (17 tonnes).
Arrival of titanium sponge was also scheduled for April 30 (56 tonnes)/May 30 (70 tonnes)/June 30 (140 tonnes)/July 30 (168 tonnes), and ferro-phosphorus for May 30 (170 tonnes)/June 30 (136 tonnes).
Arrival port was slated as the southeastern city of Pusan.
